soul_corrections.current_text: - **Weapons/props:** Energy Rifle, Plasma Machine Gun, Missiles, Minigun, Mallet, Sledgehammer; later Plasma Shotgun and Gamma Burst [Canon] ([2.4 notes][n24]; [2.9 notes][n29]), probably the 2014 art's purple-core double-barrel gun and glowing disc [Inference]. BBH: Huggable Splicer, Healing Turret [Canon] ([characters][chars]).
soul_corrections.correction: Launch kit (2.4): Energy Rifle, Plasma Machine Gun, Missiles, Minigun, Mallet, Sledgehammer [Canon]. Plasma Shotgun and Gamma Burst in 2.9 [Canon]; SkyVu calls the 2014 art 'the preview art for Saberi's new weapons' [Canon], and its twin-barrel magenta-crystal gun and magenta-rimmed saucer match the wiki-captioned in-game Plasma Shotgun and Gamma Burst models [Observed; Fan-wiki]. Later: Toxic Rifle (2.15), Landmine (2.19), ClubCobra (2.20), Social Butterfly crossbow (2.53) [Fan-wiki]. BBH: Huggable Splicer, Healing Turret [Canon].
soul_corrections.evidence: Saved SkyVu 2.9 sneak-peek copy (W/dl/saberi/official/prior/u29peek.html.txt); saberi29.png compared with P/Plasma_shotgun.png and P/Gammaburst.png; wiki Updates table and Combat Tech (BBG) class page.
